Mermaid Editor

Mermaid Syntax Reference
Flowchart:
graph TD
  A[Rectangle] --> B(Rounded)
  B --> C{Decision}
  C -->|Yes| D[Result 1]
  C -->|No| E[Result 2]
Sequence Diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  Alice->>Bob: Hello Bob
  Bob-->>Alice: Hi Alice
Class Diagram:
classDiagram
  Animal <|-- Duck
  Animal <|-- Fish
Styling:
graph TD
  A[Default] --> B[/Parallelogram/]
  A --> C[\Parallelogram alt\]
  A --> D((Circle))
  style E fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
  A --> E[Colored]
  A -->|thick red line| F[Node]
  linkStyle 5 stroke:red,stroke-width:4px
